hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_i = O_i[F]; G0001 = Newton_divided_difference[F; x, y] = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y); G0002 = F(x); G0003 = F(y).
required_assumptions: F(z) = polygamma(0, z) is defined at z = x and z = y, i.e. x and y are not nonpositive integers.
For the divided-difference operator used for G0001, x != y.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0001 is structurally the first divided difference of the digamma function F(z)=polygamma(0,z) at nodes x and y, while G0002 and G0003 are the corresponding point evaluations of the same latent function at those nodes.
